correctness.rationale: The pairwise normalized coprimality argument and integer T are proved explicitly; strict bound at a=11 gives six eligible least primes. Every prime candidate is exhausted by two integer-only divisor algorithms with matching results; the five products are verified directly. Infinite exhaustion depends on proved mathematical bounds, not bounded experiments.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Tamilvanan–Muthukrishnan Proposition 3.3 proves q<3p²,r<3p³ and contains the needed divisor precursor identity, but gives no fixed-gcd-four exact count. The 2026 minimal-gcd theorem is only gcd 2; the arithmetic-progression theorem only covers equally spaced primes and does not cover, for example, (3,7,19).

value.rationale: The minimum possible shifted-prime gcd is 2; the next possible value 4 defines a canonical structural layer of three-prime Lucas–Carmichael integers. Exhaustive classification as exactly five values, together with effective global exclusion of all larger factors, goes beyond tabulating early examples, and treats a motivated exact invariant.
